133.news_title: New LCD Range to Replace Old CRT Monitors
133.long_description:
Arcooda has released a new range of 4x3 ratio arcade LCD monitors specially designed to replace CRT monitors. 

The monitors natively support 15khz, 25khz, 31khz, up to 1080p and have been thoroughly tested on many older game boards including Street Fighter, Tekken, NBA Jam, Daytona, Mario Kart, any many more. 

All monitors offer IPS panels, 178degree viewing angle, very low response times, audio output and multiple mounting options.  An RGB colour corrector PCB is also included for easy fine tuning of colours. 

The new range of 4x3 ratio screens include 20inch, 26inch, 29inch and 33inch monitors and designed for plug and play use.
133.short_description: We are releasing a full range of 4x3 ratio arcade LCD monitors designed for the arcade game industry to replace old CRT tube monitors. These arcade LCD monitors will be direct replacement for 20inch, 26inch, 29inch and 33inch CRT tube chassis monitors with full support for 15khz, 25khz, and 31khz.
